notes: SqueekOdometer is the single contract of Squeek Odometer, a free on-chain dynamic NFT on Sepolia (chain id 11155111). Its constructor takes the Squeekchain release core-sepolia-20261103 addresses: SqueekCore proxy, SqueekNFT (Squeeks) and SqueekStaking proxy, in that order; they are immutable. The constructor reverts outside Sepolia (and local chain 31337) and makes no external calls, so a rehearsal on an empty chain succeeds. There is no owner, admin, pause, upgrade, withdrawal or payable function, and no initialization call; deployment value is zero. mint() is free, one per wallet, 9,999 in total.
